title: Come Be My Friend, Don't Be So Scared (Easy Version)
statement: The task is to choose the fewest contiguous segments over n spots in a row (n up to 2·10^5, no existing detectors in this easy version) so every spot gets a distinct set of covering segments, and output them. Contiguity rules out binary encoding: k segments cut at most 2k+1 blocks, and 2k+1 leaves both ends uncovered, so pigeonhole gives ceil(n/2) (0 for n=1), met by overlapping shifted segments.
